test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

He said, “Alas! I am a ruined man.”

options.text: He cried out with sorrow that he was a ruined man
He wished that he was a ruined man.
He applauded with sorrow that he was a ruined man.
He confessed with sorrow that he was a ruined man.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** He cried out with sorrow that he was a ruined man.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"Alas!" becomes "cried out with sorrow"**
